versions.changelog:
lanhu-code-2-el-vue v1.0.0

- Initial release: transform static Vue pages (index.vue) into dynamic Vue 2 + Element UI pages (Custom.vue) using only the target page and directly referenced CSS/resources as sources.
- Strictly enforces "single source of truth": no reading or referencing any files outside the current index.vue and its imported styles/resources.
- Requires prior execution of ui-ux-max-pro skill for UI/UX analysis before transformation can begin.
- Provides detailed, enforceable rules for file structure, dynamic data extraction, Element UI component replacement, naming conventions, and scoped styling.
- File operations must directly generate Custom.vue with full <template>, <script>, and <style scoped> blocks—never modify the original index.vue.
- Sets clear error handling for missing source files or dependencies, and defines precise usage and non-usage scenarios.
